title: The lane lint carries across a clean merge of main, in the tool-proved form only
ruling: Owner, saved on the waiting page 23:04 CST Nov 14 (05:04:25Z), picked a on page item 850 (pick-lane-lint-carry-main-merge): "850 a". Option a, exact text: "Carry the lane lint across a clean merge of main; the merge tool proves it: two parents, the second on main, the tree equals git's own merge, nothing else changed". Its gain: no 8 to 12 min lint after each move of main (6 lints and 56 min this evening, runner 10's read, unverified by triage). Its cost, as shown: the lint's pass then covers a tree it never ran on; batch CI and the PR's own run still run it. Covers the act a names and no variant: the lane lint carries only across a merge the tool proves in that form. Not covered: a merge with any other change, a conflict-resolved merge, a merge whose tree differs from git's own merge, an unreadable merge-tree (reads unknown, not carried), or any other lint-carried form. This LIFTS his earlier ruling "a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo" for this one act only; he picked the widening option knowingly (the item carried that line, widens true) over the coordinator's recommended b. It is a check change: review rounds, red first and the net-value test apply. The coordinator decides which lane builds it (lane review-carries-by-tree is the likely one).
